title: Laboratory report
description: A laboratory test report: who was tested, when, and each result with its unit, reference range and flag.

laboratory.description: The laboratory that issued the report, as printed.

report_id.description: The report, accession or order number as printed, without its label.

name.description: Given name then family name, natural capitalisation.

ordering_clinician.description: The requesting clinician's name without titles.

results.description: One entry per reported test, in printed order.

value.description: A number when the result is a plain number, else the result as printed.

flag.description: Only as the report marks the result.
